items.title: Business leaders must think like sustainability professionals, whatever their title
items.summary: Job titles will change, but next-gen sustainability thinking still gives professionals in every role an edge. The core skills are making the financial case, tracing policy and reading outside forces.

items.title: Sustainable AI: Tools, frameworks and best practices in 2026
items.summary: Sustainability professionals are scrambling to understand how AI adoption will impact environmental goals.

items.title: New tool helps Etsy peer into the ‘black box’ of AI emissions
items.summary: Sustainable AI Group, the company co-founded by former Salesforce sustainability manager Boris Gamazaychikov, has released a resource for measuring the energy and emissions produced by proprietary artificial intelligence models.

items.title: New emissions accounting rules win backing from companies and nonprofits
items.summary: Plans for a major expansion of how companies report emissions have won widespread support from the public and private sector.

items.title: Why ISO 14001’s evolution signals a new era for sustainability professionals
items.summary: For decades, environmental management occupied a defined space within organisations.

items.title: Study: UK banks emerge as Europe’s biggest coal financiers
items.summary: UK banks provided $8.3bn in loans and underwriting to coal companies between 2022 and 2025 – more than any other country in Europe.

items.title: GridEx launches to drive the digital transformation of Europe’s electricity grids
items.summary: GridEx, a new sister brand to edie, will examine the technologies, investment and infrastructure needed to digitalise Europe’s electricity grids and support the continent’s clean energy transition.

items.title: Report: Shipping transition falls behind as demand for zero-emission fuels weakens
items.summary: New research has found that shipping is falling behind the pace needed to meet its 2030 climate targets, with demand for zero-emission fuels weakening, orders for compatible vessels declining and international regulation still unresolved.

items.title: ONE WEEK TO GO: The Autumn Budget – How businesses can cut waste, control costs and prepare for 2027
items.summary: In one week edie will host its latest webinar, in partnership with JRP Solutions, exploring how businesses can cut waste, control costs and plan effectively for the year ahead.

items.title: Recycled polyester to enter Primark clothing from 2029
items.summary: Primark has agreed a multi-year deal with textile recycling company Circ to introduce recycled polyester made from textile waste into its clothing from 2029.
